author: benjaminion
content: I've updated [the agenda](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2291) for tomorrow's ACDC. I want to devote the bulk of the time to a discussion of our post-Devcon priorities and roadmap, structured around three big questions. Please come with views and be prepared to share them - it's important that we gather the full range of input. I will try to moderate the conversation to keep us focused and making progress, and ensure that we don't only hear the loudest voices - wish me luck 😅
